dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate trailing edge characterized by a smooth, continuous concave spline profile originating from the posterior basal notch to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex morphology with a measurable pixel radius; lacks acute or sharp-angled termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin with an approximate 45-degree incline relative to the horizontal basal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Calculated ratio of maximum basal width to vertical height is approximately 1.1:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a distinct structural notch at the posterior base of the trailing edge; pervasive white punctate markings/speckling distributed across the lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dorso-ventral color gradient transitioning from a dark melanistic dorsal section to a lighter grey-white lateral band along the base.
